assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for a top-down 2D game garden arena, matching the warm detailed hand-painted storybook style of the reference. Exactly straight overhead orthographic, single centered isolated object, generous transparent margins. Crisp painted materials and clear silhouette at small screen size. No characters, face, eyes, lettering, UI, grid, watermark, backdrop or ground plane; true transparent background. A small dark burrow entrance in soil. Compact irregular circular nearly-black hole surrounded by a narrow rugged ring of brown earth, a few tiny pebbles and short dry root strands. Circular overhead aperture, not a frontal cave. Warm upper-left highlights, muted low-saturation brown rim. No metallic rim, no water, no huge pit, no animals, no stone masonry. The opening itself stays dark and the outer silhouette is compact.
